content.text:
No. Since agents 0.20.0, the MCP client (`MCPClientConnection`) first probes with `server/discover`, which is how Stateless MCP servers negotiate. It only falls back to the `initialize` handshake, on the same connection, when the server needs it: Legacy Streamable HTTP, SSE and RPC servers. Your installed agents 0.27.0 works this way, and its own docs say so (`node_modules/agents/docs/mcp-client.md:191`). The project's Ludion lessons say the same thing.

One catch: some settings only take effect during `initialize`, such as which elicitation modes the client advertises (`mcp-client.md:220`). A server that goes the Stateless route never sees that handshake.
